issue.title: Configure hangs when using vcpkg toolchain file

repository.name: vscode-cmake-tools
repository.description: CMake Tools provides a robust, convenient workflow for CMake projects in VS Code. It simplifies configurations with CMake presets, supports IntelliSense and built-in debugging for CMake scripts, and offers configurable tasks. Its customizable interface allows for efficient project control, while also simplifying test execution and monitoring.

issue.body:
Hi,

I've been unable to configure my cmake project using the vcpkg toolchain file, it seems to hang when trying to get the windows SDK version (via a powershell script included in vcpkg).

I'm not sure how cmake is called in the background of your tool but is there any reason why a powershell script called by cmake would behave differently when cmake is called from this tool vs the command line? Cmake configures correctly when calling cmake directly in the VSCode terminal.

body:
Thanks for such a detailed issue report!

I'd be happy to merge a PR if you'd make one, or I can make the change myself (I'll do that locally for testing now).

I was unable to use the cmake-tools extension locally to fully reproduce the issue, but it didn't introduce any regressions so I've merged the change.

Thanks again for reporting this issue!
